execution_lock_reason: Task IDs, upstream revisions, adapters, and approach hashes must be frozen after calibration and before paid runs.

studies.question: Given the same model, environment, tools, objective, and budget, which architecture completes more difficult real-world tasks?
Does experience acquired on development tasks improve results on distinct held-out tasks?
What can each mutation unit express and safely retain when allowed to use its native strengths?

suites.score: resolved instances / total, plus fail-to-pass and pass-to-pass test counts
suites.why_hard: Real GitHub issues in unfamiliar repositories; patches must satisfy official tests without regressions.
End-to-end terminal work spanning builds, debugging, servers, data processing, and system configuration.

suites.score: normalized held-out competition score and improvement over supplied seed
suites.isolation: pinned MLE-bench container with hidden grading split
suites.why_hard: Agents must inspect data, build experiments, train models, and improve a continuous score rather than merely pass examples.

suites.dataset: two METR Task Standard R&D environments
suites.why_hard: Long-horizon autonomous AI R&D with measurable performance on held-out data.
Requires understanding a research paper and constructing a substantial replication codebase.

suites.dataset: five multi-stage ActiveGraph systems with 50 sealed checks each
suites.score: checks passed / 50, with hard authority and replay gates
suites.isolation: fresh container, sealed evaluator package, cold replay
suites.why_hard: Measures partial improvement from a deliberately incomplete 20/50 seed through schemas, relations, policies, replay, composition, and adversarial events.

global_rules: The model, provider, task image, task prompt, brokered tools, and outer budget are identical across approaches.
Development and evaluation task identities are disjoint.
Official or sealed graders are never mounted into the agent-visible filesystem.
A direct cold baseline, evolved arm, cold ablation, and sham-improvement control are recorded separately.
No retry is silently discarded; failed attempts consume budget and remain in the trace.
All headline results report per-task outcomes and uncertainty, not only an aggregate mean.
No paid execution begins while execution_enabled is false.
